# Blocks of docs/quick-start.md the replay does not drive, and the catalog
# entries each of them quotes.
#
# TestTheQuickStartMatchesTheTool and
# TestEveryExemptBlockDeclaresTheCatalogEntriesItQuotes read this file. An
# exempt block is a block nothing runs, so every entry here is a finding rather
# than a line of configuration: it says a transcript a reader trusts is held by
# no replay. Five assertions keep the pressure on. An entry naming a block the
# replay does drive fails, so a stale entry is pruned rather than left to
# accumulate. An entry carrying no reason fails. An exempt block with no entry
# fails. An entry carrying neither quotes= nor quotes=none fails. And a
# quotes=none entry that does not say because what fails.
#
# An entry is the line its fence opens at, then key=value directives whose
# values may carry spaces: reason=, quotes=, and because=. quotes= names the
# catalog keys whose stored text renders into the block, comma separated, and
# the declaration is maximal, so a key the discovery rule finds and the entry
# leaves out fails.
#
# An entry opening `inner` names a marker-shaped line that is a block's content
# rather than a fence, which the day somebody documents this document's own
# console grammar inside it will need: a four-backtick outer fence wrapping a
# three-backtick example is well formed, and the line scan behind the fence
# arithmetic has no state with which to see that. The document carries no
# nested fence today, so no such entry stands here.
